scenario: Synthetic identifiers are derived from source text per LDET.6.4.1 — two compilations of identical source produce identical synthetic names. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: a program with a logical schema `Widget` compiles once. Comparing two compilations' synthetic names needs two compiles and a read of their output, which `compile_ok` does neither of.
rules_ds:
schema Widget scope logical:
    size: Int key

rule r:
    Widget w where w.size > 0
->
    log info "ok"
